tagline: Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations.
hero_kpi_rationale: Operating margin is the key KPI for Leidos because it reflects the company's ability to convert its significant government revenues into operating profits, demonstrating the operational efficiency and cost discipline essential in its environment.
company_description: Leidos Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides services and solutions for government and commercial customers in the United States and internationally. The National Security & Digital segment provides national security software; services by using artificial intelligence and machine learning to coordinate sea, ground, air, and space to help warfighters; offensive, defensive, and physical cyber operation solutions; intelligence analysis, operational support, logistics operations, security, linguistics, force production, biometrics, chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosives, energetics, training, and other services; and Digital Modernization and transformation services. The Health & Civil segment offers air traffic control systems; health mission software; managed health services; infrastructure management and operation; logistical operations and information technology support; and life science research and development support services. kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, indicating the profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Reflects the company's ability to generate profits from its core activities.
kpis.signal: Operating profitability growth through effective management.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of income generated from sales of goods and services.
kpis.description: Key indicator of the company's size and business growth.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth, supported by new contracts and increased volumes.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Measures the direct profitability of the company's activities before accounting for other expenses.

kpis.name: Government Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenues derived from U.S. government contracts.
kpis.description: Indicator of revenue concentration with U.S. government customers, the primary growth driver.
kpis.signal: High and stable dependence on government contracts, primarily DoD and Intelligence Community.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Represents the size of the company's workforce, a key factor for execution capacity.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount, indicating a consolidation phase following growth.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Measures the profitability of the company's core operations.
kpis.signal: Strong operating income growth due to contract wins and increased volumes.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $17.174B for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.448B for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.43 for the last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.211B for the last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 14.6% for the last year.

kpis.name: National Security Digital Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin of the National Security Digital segment, which provides advanced technology services to federal government customers.
kpis.description: Indicator of the National Security Digital segment's profitability amid competition.
kpis.signal: Gradual profitability improvement in the segment through contract wins and increased volumes.

kpis.name: Health Civil Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin of the Health Civil segment, the most profitable segment with managed health services.
kpis.description: Indicator of the strong profitability of the Health Civil segment, a key profit driver.
kpis.signal: Highly profitable segment with continuous improvement through operational efficiencies.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Shows the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Government Dependence
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on U.S. government contracts (87% of revenues), primarily from the DoD and the Intelligence Community. A loss of reputation or relationship with government agencies could have a major negative impact on future revenues.
risks.score_rationale: 87% of revenues come from U.S. government contracts. A reduction in government budgets, loss of relationship with federal agencies, or change in government priorities could have a significant impact on future revenues. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Government Budget Reduction
risks.summary: A potential reduction in government budgets in the defense and homeland security sectors could have a significant impact on future revenues and limit growth prospects.
risks.score_rationale: Although the presidential administration has not indicated a desire to reduce spending in the defense and homeland security sectors, the magnitude and duration of current spending levels remain uncertain. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.summary: The company faces intense competition, amplified by the shift toward multiple-award and IDIQ contracts, which reduces backlogs and creates pricing pressures.
risks.score_rationale: Trends in the government procurement process include a shift toward multiple-award contracts using IDIQ and GSA contracts, which has increased competition and pricing pressures. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.summary: Current and future geopolitical events could have a negative impact on the markets in which the company operates and on operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Current and future geopolitical events could have a negative impact on markets and government budget priorities in which the company operates. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity breaches could have a negative impact on the company's business and financial results, particularly due to its dependence on sensitive government contracts.
risks.score_rationale: Leidos provides critical services to the U.S. government and intelligence community. Cybersecurity breaches could impact customer trust and contracts. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: International Exposure and Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Changes in international laws, regulations, and trade policies, including tariffs, could impact procurement costs and financial results.
risks.score_rationale: 8% of revenues come from international markets. Changes in international laws, regulations, and trade policies could affect business operations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on technology to deliver its services, particularly in digital modernization and cybersecurity. A major technology failure could have a negative impact on business operations.
risks.score_rationale: Leidos relies heavily on technology to deliver its digital modernization, cybersecurity, and software solutions services. A technology failure could impact execution capabilities. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Leidos mentions artificial intelligence and automation as key components of its digital transformation and operational efficiency strategy. The company uses AI to improve its business processes through its Enterprise Transformation Office.
evidence: continual improvements in the effectiveness and efficiency of our business processes driven by our enterprise transformation office leveraging artificial intelligence and automation
